description: PB-77 is a Sub-Regional Transport Office (Sub-RTO) located in Guru Har Sahai, a subdivision of the Ferozepur district in Punjab. The office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport tax collection for the Guru Har Sahai region.
address: SDM Office Complex, Guru Har Sahai, District Ferozepur, Punjab
